title: The Depression and work for the band
summary: Work continued but there was much less music during the Depression.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Did he still continue on playing in it?
Who, Miles? Yeah. So I used to play when the Depression was, but they didn't get as much music to play, you know, as they did before. But they'd get some, but not as half as much, you know.
I just wondered if he got a job with one of those government bands, you know.
